verdict_rationale: 5 of 28 ACs pass (15 partial, 8 fail). The election library produces plausible data shapes but: (a) 17/17 AC §3 test files named by the AC SoT do not exist and were never committed; (b) the two failure-mode ACs that give the domain its meaning (SILENT_SWITCH, SILENT_NONE) have zero code; (c) mid-turn switch results never reach the election/audit trail, so the audit answers the wrong provider; (d) pin RBAC is bypassable by omitting the role argument; (e) the guarantee vocabulary violates the 8.1 host-contract DoD (G-DEGRADED is a 4th level; G-SCOPE/G-ADVISORY never exist); (f) nothing outside qc tests imports the v2 host code — installed host packages depend on v1 @mu/harness-eso-core.

extra_defect.title: dispatch() returns status ok without acting
evidence: eso/core/src/host-contract.mjs:77 — 'dispatch(action) { return { host: 'cursor', executed: action, status: 'ok' }; }' (identical at :93 and :109)
probe: a.dispatch({write:'/tmp/eso-dd/should-not-exist.txt', body:'x'}) returned {"status":"ok"} and the file was never created — a success report for work that did not happen
extra_defect.why_it_matters: The adapter is the only place a host action could be executed; returning {status:'ok'} unconditionally makes any caller believe the host ran the action. It is a stub-shaped success, and no test asserts that a side effect occurred.

defects.proof: eso/adapters/src/election.mjs:129 — 'export function handleMidTurnBranchFailure({ currentElection, failureReason, branches = {}, uninstalledProviders = [] } = {})' has no turnAuditLog parameter; probe: after switching external->none, auditLog length stayed 1 and queryTurnProviderAudit returned ['external']
defects.impact: AC-HOST-03-01 postcondition 'elections có 2 mục' unmet; AC-HOST-03-03 and AC-HOST-05-01/03 report the dead provider as active — 'vì sao khác' is unanswerable, which is the whole point of the story.

defects.title: SILENT_SWITCH and SILENT_NONE do not exist anywhere in product code
defects.proof: grep 'SILENT_SWITCH|SILENT_NONE' over eso/ and packages/ (--include=*.mjs) — 0 matches; the only hits are sdlc docs (e.g. 28.switch.md:37). No refusal path, no error code, no detector.
defects.impact: Three failure ACs (01-03, 02-03, 03-02) cannot pass: the system can neither detect an unrecorded switch nor refuse one. The ACs were written specifically to make silent degradation a defect.

defects.title: 17/17 AC §3 test files missing, never committed; the substitute tests assert data shapes and encode a wrong vocabulary
defects.proof: MISSING: qc/eso-host-election.test.mjs — does not exist (git log --all for the path: empty for all 17 names). Substitute qc/eso-adapter-election.test.mjs:14 asserts the constant BRANCH_ORDER; :91 asserts 'G-DEGRADED'; :218 asserts only record length. sdlc/06.analysis/04.quality-control/06.host.md:83 — '27 planned · 0 executed'.
defects.impact: No AC has a per-AC proof. The strict baseline ('a test asserts it') is not met for any of the 28 ACs by the named tests; the two consolidated files pass while the behaviour they claim to prove is absent.

key_questions_answered.dispatch_returns_ok_without_acting_allow: No. The adapter is the only place a host action could run; returning a constant {status:'ok'} (host-contract.mjs:77/93/109) makes every caller believe the host executed the action. Probe: dispatch({write:'/tmp/.../should-not-exist.txt'}) reported ok and created no file. A stub-shaped success is precisely the 'returns success without acting' pattern the baseline excludes.
key_questions_answered.election_against_real_capabilities_or_fi: Fixtures. election.mjs:22 takes 'branches = {}' from the caller; the only real capability matrix (host-contract.mjs:61-110) is never read, and KNOWN_HOSTS (election.mjs:15) is a third hardcoded list. No probe exists.
key_questions_answered.pin_persisted_anywhere: No. setCapabilityPin (election.mjs:209-234) returns a plain object; grep for pins/capabilityPin/pinned outside election.mjs returns nothing; no config file or db write. A pin cannot survive a turn boundary.
key_questions_answered.mid_turn_switch_recorded_with_reason: Reason and history yes (election.mjs:196-206); recording no — the function has no audit-log parameter and appends nothing. Audit log does NOT reflect it: probe kept the old 'external' row and the audit query returned 'external' while the active branch was 'none'.
key_questions_answered.turn_audit_real_store_or_array: In-memory array supplied by the caller (election.mjs:238 'auditLog = []'), with no production caller and no wiring to eso/evidence recorder/db. Default call answers with an empty list plus the message 'turn không dùng năng lực nào'.
